title: Final Energy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The energy of the emitted photon is correctly calculated as approximately 2.234 MeV.

title: Recoil Importance Assessment
description: Important Criteria: The analysis correctly concludes that the recoil of the deuteron is negligible compared to the photon energy.

title: Final Neutron Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The energy required for the neutron to undergo capture is accurately determined as 10.32 MeV.

title: Center of Mass Treatment
description: Important Criteria: The use of the center-of-mass frame and reduced mass in the calculations is correctly applied.

title: Momentum Relationship
description: Important Criteria: The relationship between the momenta of the neutron and the captured state is correctly established.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All units are consistently used throughout the calculations, enhancing clarity.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors such as sign mistakes in energy calculations are avoided.

title: Approximation Justification
description: Optional Criteria: The approximations made during calculations are clearly justified and reasonable.
